title: Neuroblastoma: risk group decides treatment
alt: Diagnosis and staging lead to a risk group; low risk is observed or resected, intermediate risk gets surgery and moderate-dose chemotherapy, high risk gets intensive multimodal therapy.
caption: After COG and SIOPEN risk stratification.

nodes.text: Imaging, MIBG scan, biopsy with MYCN status, bone marrow
Observation, or surgery alone; chemotherapy only for organ-threatening symptoms
Induction chemotherapy, surgery, myeloablative therapy with stem cell rescue, radiotherapy, immunotherapy
